description: React component for client-side file ingestion UI in a Next.js application, handling file uploads, previews, and user interactions for building a career persona.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte count into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label in uppercase or 'FILE' if none.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a random alphanumeric string used as a unique ID.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for an upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns the display title for an upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the accent color associated with an upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns a string of accepted file extensions for upload.
